description: crl.rs line 110: reason as u8 where CrlReason is #[repr(u32)]. All defined CrlReason values (0-10, per RFC 5280 §5.3.1) fit in a u8, so the cast is lossless for any value that parses successfully. Unknown reason codes >10 would be rejected by the DER parser as an unrecognized enum variant before reaching this code, so no truncation occurs in practice. However, the cast is semantically unsound: if x509-cert ever adds a reason code >255, or if a future caller uses a raw discriminant, the cast silently truncates. The idiomatic fix is to use u32 for reason_code in Error::Revoked and avoid the cast entirely.
title: extract_reason_code casts CrlReason (repr u32) to u8
